items.title: Clarence Gabriel Interview
items.q: Well, that was another little band that we had together. Lacroix, Fyre.

ctx.x: Used to play in the Beerus too. Oh yeah. Arnensboro, the Lothel Street.

Down the Beerus? Down the river. That is it. Right by Hatch. Boywoods. Used to play way down in the mountain. Boywood is that place where you have to get the boat to go. And the Beerus you have to take that mail boat and go. Mail boat and go down the river. That's Ireland. They got the rec resort, they got the grocery, they got the dance hall. They got the oil station. Most boats stopped and refueled. Call it Boywood. I used to play that with Paul Moje. Yeah, absolutely. Old man Moje, Lacroix. That's correct.…
